definition_zh: 许诺；答应；承诺；诺言；希望；前途
definition_en: to say firmly that one will do something, the statement so made, and the signs that something good is likely to come
core_image: 两只手伸出去一击为定，把一句还看不见的话变成双方都得守住的东西
scene: 临行前，父亲把旧钥匙放进儿子手里，说定秋天一定回来看那棵老树。Before he left, he promised to come back for the harvest.
sceneCN: 这里表示「许诺、答应」（第 1 个义项：明确说出自己一定会做某事）；句意为他在离开之前答应回来参加秋收。

pos.zh: 许诺；答应；有希望
诺言；承诺；希望；前途

derivatives.zh: 由 promise 加 -ing 构成，义为「有前途的；有希望的」
由拉丁词干 promiss- 加 -ory 构成，义为「承诺的；约定的」，常见于法律文书
由 promising 再加 -ly 构成，义为「有希望地；看来不错地」

senses.title: To say firmly that one will do something
senses.definition: to tell someone that you will certainly do something, so that the other person can count on it
senses.definitionCN: 明确告诉某人自己一定会做某事，使对方可以指望
senses.example: She promised to call as soon as she landed.
senses.exampleCN: 她答应一下飞机就打电话。
senses.why: The Latin verb sent a word forward toward the listener, so the act begins as a message travelling out of the speaker's mouth.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词的意思是「把话往前送」，所以这个动作起初是一句话从说话人嘴里飞向听者。

senses.title: A statement that one will certainly do something
senses.definition: a statement in which someone says that they will certainly do something
senses.definitionCN: 某人说定自己一定会做某事的说法
senses.example: He kept every promise he made that summer.
senses.exampleCN: 那个夏天他许下的每个诺言都守住了。
senses.why: Once spoken, the message no longer belongs to the speaker alone; it can be kept, quoted or thrown back, which is how the verb turns into the thing itself.
senses.whyCN: 话一出口就不再只属于说话人，它会被收着、被引用、被拿出来对质；动词就这样变成了那个被送出的东西。

senses.title: To show signs that something good is likely
senses.definition: to give signs that something good or important is likely to happen
senses.definitionCN: 显出好结果或重要事情很可能发生的迹象
senses.example: The early sales figures promise a strong year.
senses.exampleCN: 早期销售数字预示着这一年会很不错。
senses.why: A pledge always leans toward a future that has not arrived; when clouds or numbers do the leaning, the word keeps only that forward look and drops the speaker.
senses.whyCN: 诺言本就朝着一个还没到来的将来倾斜；当乌云或数字在倾斜时，这个词只留下「朝前指」的动作，说话人则退场了。

senses.title: The quality of seeming likely to succeed
senses.definition: the quality of seeming likely to succeed, especially in a young person or a new project
senses.definitionCN: 看起来很可能成功的那份质地，尤指年轻人或新项目身上的
senses.example: The young pianist showed promise from her first recital.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻钢琴家从第一场独奏会起就显出前途。
senses.why: If the good thing is promised but has not arrived, the noun can name that waiting good thing directly, and English does so especially for talent that has not yet proved itself.
senses.whyCN: 如果好事已被许诺却还没到，名词就能直接指那件正在等着的好事；英语尤其用它来说尚未证明自己的才华。

intro.en: Promise comes from a Latin verb meaning to send a word forward, and the English word still has the shape of a message flying toward someone who will hold you to it.
intro.cn: promise 来自一个意为「把话往前送」的拉丁动词，这个词至今保持着「一句话飞向对方，对方据此要求你兑现」的形状。

items.en: Mittere meant to send or to let go, and it sits inside many English words about sending and releasing.
items.cn: mittere 意为送出、放走，是许多表示「送出、释放」的英语词里的那个成分。

items.en: The prefix pro- pushed the sending forward, so promittere meant to send a word forth, that is, to give someone your word.
items.cn: 前缀 pro- 把「送」推向前面，于是 promittere 意为把话送出去，也就是向人许下诺言。

items.en: The participle promissum named the thing sent forth rather than the sending, and it is the direct source of the noun.
items.cn: 分词 promissum 指被送出的那个东西，而不是送的动作，是名词义项的直接来源。

items.en: Old French kept the noun as promesse, meaning a pledge, and English borrowed it with the ending reshaped as promise.
items.cn: 古法语把这个名词写作 promesse，意为诺言，英语借入时把词尾改成 promise。

items.en: English uses the verb for giving one's word and the noun for the word given, then stretches both to the hopeful signs that point at a good future.
items.cn: 现代英语用动词指给出承诺，用名词指给出的那句话，再把两者扩展到指向美好未来的种种迹象。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin verb of sending, including a legal pair for the two sides of a pledge; the second group gathers words for solemn promises.
note.cn: 第一组共用表示「送出」的拉丁动词，还包括指承诺双方的一对法律用语；第二组收表示郑重许诺的词。

entries.definition: Relating to a promise, especially one that has legal force.
entries.definitionCN: 与承诺有关的，尤指具有法律效力的承诺。

entries.definition: In law, the person to whom a promise is made.
entries.definitionCN: 法律用语，指接受承诺的一方。

entries.definition: In law, the person who makes a promise.
entries.definitionCN: 法律用语，指做出承诺的一方。

entries.definition: A statement assumed true as a basis for reasoning; it shares the Latin verb of sending but not the sense of pledging.
entries.definitionCN: 推理时被当作前提的陈述；与本词共用拉丁「送」动词，但没有许诺之义。

entries.definition: A serious promise, often backed by something given as security.
entries.definitionCN: 郑重的承诺，常以某物作担保。

entries.definition: A solemn promise, especially one about marriage or faith.
entries.definitionCN: 庄严的誓愿，尤指关于婚姻或信仰的。

entries.definition: A formal promise made before a witness or on something sacred.
entries.definitionCN: 在见证人面前或对神圣之物做出的正式承诺。

entries.definition: A statement meant to give someone confidence about the future.
entries.definitionCN: 意在让人对将来安心的说法。

normalIntro.en: Every sense keeps the picture of a word sent forward: someone speaks, the word travels, and the listener is then entitled to expect something.
normalIntro.cn: 每个义项都保留着「一句话被送出去」的画面：有人开口，话飞过去，听的人从此有权期待某件事。

normal.en: Mittere is Latin for to send, and pro- pushes it forward, so promittere is to send a word ahead of you.
normal.cn: mittere 是拉丁语的「送」，pro- 把它往前推，所以 promittere 就是「把话先送出去」。

normal.en: Promissum is the thing that was sent, which is why the noun means the word given and not the act of giving it.
normal.cn: promissum 是被送出的那个东西，所以名词义指说出的那句话，而不是说这句话的动作。

normal.en: Promising adds -ing to describe someone or something that already looks like a coming success.
normal.cn: promising 加 -ing，用来形容已经显出成功样子的年轻人或事物。

normal.en: Weather that promises rain keeps only the forward-pointing part of a pledge, with nobody actually pledging.
normal.cn: 天气 promise rain 只保留了许诺中「朝前指」的那一半，并没有谁真的在许诺。

normal.en: Keep and break fit promise because a pledge is treated like an object held in the hand or dropped on the floor.
normal.cn: keep 与 break 能配 promise，是因为诺言被当成手里的东西：可以握住，也可以摔掉。

abstract.en: A promise is a word lent forward in time, and the debt is settled when that future finally arrives.
abstract.cn: 诺言是一句被借到将来的话，等那个将来真的到来，债才算还清。

abstract.en: One word covers a pledge and a hopeful sign because both are the present pointing at something not yet here.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指誓言，也指好兆头，因为两者都是「现在」在指向尚未到来的东西。

abstract.en: To promise is to make your future self answerable to another person's memory of what you said.
abstract.cn: 许诺就是让你的将来那个自己去面对别人记住的那句话。

examples.en: She promised to send the file before noon.
examples.cn: 她答应中午前把文件发过去。

examples.en: He broke his promise and never mentioned it again.
examples.cn: 他违背了诺言，此后再没提起。

examples.en: The new treatment promises to help patients who failed older drugs.
examples.cn: 这种新疗法有望帮助那些对旧药无效的病人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普若米事」——说出口的事像米粒撒出去，收不回来，只能认账；记住 promise 是许诺。

root: 拉丁语 pro-（向前）+ mittere（送、放出）→ promittere（把话送出去、许下诺言）→ promissum（被送出的承诺），经古法语 promesse 进入英语；同族词多与「送出、放出」有关，premise 与本词共用 mittere，但前缀不同、意义也走远。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is a word sent forward to bind the speaker; from it come the pledge itself, the hopeful sign, and the promise that a future holds.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是「一句被送出去、用来约束说话人的话」；由此分出那句诺言本身、指向好结果的迹象，以及关于前途的希望。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands meeting in a hard clasp, turning spoken words into something both sides must keep.
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手用力一击，把说出口的话变成双方都得守住的东西。

branches.en: a hand stretched out before the sentence is finished
branches.cn: 话还没说完，手已经伸了出去

branches.en: a written pledge folded away in a drawer
branches.cn: 写下来的承诺折好收进抽屉

branches.en: dark clouds carrying the smell of coming rain
branches.cn: 带着雨意的乌云压在天边

branches.en: a young musician whose future seems already waiting
branches.cn: 前途仿佛已经在前方等着的年轻乐手

branches.en: one word for a vow and for a hope
branches.cn: 同一个词既指誓言，也指希望

intro.en: A Latin verb of sending, its forward prefix, and the endings that turn the message into a noun and an adjective hold the word together.
intro.cn: 表示「送」的拉丁动词、表示向前的前缀，以及把这句话变成名词与形容词的词尾，共同支撑这个词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb promittere and its participle promissum are the reliable cognates behind the English noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 promittere 及其分词 promissum，是英语这个词可靠的同源词。

items.meaning: to send forth a word, to promise
that which is sent forth, a promise

latinEntries.meaning: to send forth a word, to promise

definition_zh: 提升；晋升；促进；推动；推销；宣传；（棋）升变
definition_en: to move someone or something to a higher position, or to encourage its growth or acceptance
core_image: 一只手把一个人从台阶的下层托到上一层
scene: 公司年会上，经理把一位做了五年的一线员工叫到台前。The manager decided to promote her from team leader to department head after five years on the line.
sceneCN: 这里 promote 是「提升、晋升」（第 1 个义项：把某人移到更高的职位）；句意：经理决定把在一线做了五年的她从组长提升为部门主管。图中可辨识物件：舞台、晋升名单、新工牌、握手、掌声；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 提升；晋升；促进；推销；宣传

derivatives.zh: 晋升；促销；推广
发起人； promoter
促销的；宣传的
未晋升的

senses.title: Advance someone in rank
senses.definition: to move a person to a higher position or rank
senses.definitionCN: 把某人移到更高的职位或等级
senses.example: She was promoted to department head.
senses.exampleCN: 她被提升为部门主管。
senses.why: Latin promovere means 'move forward': pro- 'forward' plus movere 'to move'. A promotion moves a person up the institutional ladder.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 promovere 意为“向前移动”：pro-“向前”加 movere“移动”。晋升就是把一个人沿机构的梯子往上移。

senses.title: Encourage growth or success
senses.definition: to help something grow, develop, or succeed
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某事物成长、发展或成功
senses.example: The policy promotes small businesses.
senses.exampleCN: 这项政策促进小企业。
senses.why: The object changes from a person to a process: what is promoted is made to move forward. The word becomes a general verb of support.
senses.whyCN: 对象从人变成过程：被 promote 的东西被推着向前。这个词变成泛用的支持动词。

senses.title: Advertise or publicize
senses.definition: to make a product, idea, or event known in order to sell or gain support
senses.definitionCN: 使产品、理念或活动为人所知，以销售或争取支持
senses.example: The company promotes its new phone online.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在网上推销新手机。
senses.why: Commerce borrows the ladder image: a product is moved forward in the market, pushed toward buyers. Promotion becomes the noun of marketing.
senses.whyCN: 商业借来梯子意象：产品在市场中被向前推，推向买家。promotion 于是成了营销名词。

senses.title: Move a pupil to the next grade
senses.definition: to advance a student to the next class or level
senses.definitionCN: 把学生升到下一个班级或年级
senses.example: All students were promoted to the next grade.
senses.exampleCN: 所有学生都升到了下一个年级。
senses.why: Schools use the same upward motion: a pupil moves from one level to the next. The opposite, to hold back, keeps the spatial logic.
senses.whyCN: 学校用同一个向上运动：学生从一级移到下一级。反义词“留级”保留同样的空间逻辑。

senses.title: Cause an idea or cause to advance
senses.definition: to help a cause, idea, or value become stronger or more accepted
senses.definitionCN: 帮助事业、理念或价值变得更强、更被接受
senses.example: The campaign promotes healthy eating.
senses.exampleCN: 这场运动推广健康饮食。
senses.why: Public language treats values as objects that can be pushed forward. To promote peace is to give it momentum in the world.
senses.whyCN: 公共语言把价值当作可被推向前方的物体。promote peace 就是让和平在世界上获得动量。

senses.title: Advance a pawn in chess
senses.definition: in chess, to move a pawn to the last rank and replace it with a stronger piece
senses.definitionCN: 国际象棋中，把兵走到对方底线并换成更强的子
senses.example: The pawn was promoted to a queen.
senses.exampleCN: 那个兵升变为后。
senses.why: Chess gives the ladder literal form: a lowly pawn reaches the far rank and becomes a queen. The metaphor of advancement becomes a rule of the game.
senses.whyCN: 国际象棋把梯子变成字面规则：卑微的兵走到远端，变成后。“晋升”隐喻成了游戏规则。

senses.title: Move a team to a higher league
senses.definition: in sport, to move a club or player to a higher division
senses.definitionCN: 体育中把俱乐部或选手升到更高级别
senses.example: The club was promoted to the first division.
senses.exampleCN: 该俱乐部升入甲级。
senses.why: League tables rank teams by results. Promotion is the reward for finishing high, and relegation is its mirror. The word makes sport a visible ladder.
senses.whyCN: 联赛积分榜按成绩给球队排序。升级是名列前茅的奖赏，降级是它的镜像。这个词让体育成了一条可见的梯子。

senses.title: Accelerate a chemical reaction
senses.definition: in chemistry, to increase the rate of a reaction
senses.definitionCN: 化学中加快反应速率
senses.example: The catalyst promotes the reaction.
senses.exampleCN: 催化剂促进该反应。
senses.why: A catalyst moves a reaction forward without being consumed. Science uses promote for any agent that speeds a process, keeping the 'move forward' core.
senses.whyCN: 催化剂推动反应向前，自身不被消耗。科学用 promote 指任何加速过程的因素，保留“向前移动”核心。

senses.title: Push forward physically (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, to move something forward in space
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：把某物在空间中向前推
senses.example: The crowd promoted him toward the door.
senses.exampleCN: 人群把他推向门口。
senses.why: This is the literal Latin sense, now rare. Modern English keeps it mainly in the abstract ladder, but the physical push is still visible in the metaphor.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁字面义，现已罕见。现代英语主要在抽象梯子中保留它，但物理的“推”仍能在隐喻中看见。

intro.en: Promote is a forward-motion word: Latin promovere joins pro- 'forward' to movere 'to move'. English borrowed it in the late 14c. and then applied the same push to careers, causes, products, and pawns.
intro.cn: promote 是一个向前运动的词：拉丁语 promovere 把 pro-“向前”与 movere“移动”结合。英语在 14 世纪末借入，随后把同一推动用到职业、事业、产品与棋子。

items.en: First recorded with the sense 'advance, further, encourage'.
items.cn: 最早记录为“推进、促进、鼓励”。

items.en: From Latin promovere 'move forward, advance, bring forward' = pro- 'forward' + movere 'to move'.
items.cn: 来自拉丁语 promovere“向前移、推进、带上前”= pro-“向前”+ movere“移动”。

items.en: movere also gives move, remove, motive, emotion, and moment. The family is about motion, and pro- turns it into forward motion.
items.cn: movere 还生成 move、remove、motive、emotion、moment。这个词族关乎运动，pro- 把它变成向前运动。

items.en: The senses 'raise to a higher office' and 'help forward a cause' become established.
items.cn: “提升到更高职位”与“推动某项事业”的义项确立。

items.en: Commercial promotion appears: advertising pushes goods toward buyers.
items.cn: 商业推广义出现：广告把商品推向买家。

items.en: Modern English uses promote for careers, health, products, teams, and chemical reactions, always with the same forward push.
items.cn: 现代英语用 promote 指职业、健康、产品、球队与化学反应，始终是同一个向前推动。

note.en: The first group shares the movere root and the -mote shape; the second is about verbs that also mean raising or supporting.
note.cn: 第一组共享 movere 词根与 -mote 形态，第二组看同样表示“提升”或“支持”的动词。

entries.definition: a rise in rank; a marketing campaign.
entries.definitionCN: 晋升；促销活动。

entries.definition: a person who organizes or backs an event or business.
entries.definitionCN: 发起人；承办者。

entries.definition: far away, literally 'moved back'. It is re- 'back' + movere.
entries.definitionCN: 遥远的，字面“被移开”。它是 re-“向后”+ movere。

entries.definition: to move forward or raise in rank. It overlaps promote but is less institutional.
entries.definitionCN: 向前移动或提升等级。它与 promote 重叠，但更少机构色彩。

entries.definition: to give someone confidence or help something grow. It names morale and support, not position.
entries.definitionCN: 给某人信心或助长某事。它命名士气与支持，而非职位。

entries.definition: to make something widely known. It matches the advertising sense but not the career sense.
entries.definitionCN: 使某事广为人知。它对应推销义，不对应职业义。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin movere 'move', the pro- 'forward' prefix, the promotion/promoter pair, and the chess and league uses.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 movere“移动”、前缀 pro-“向前”、promotion/promoter 这对词，以及国际象棋与联赛用法。

normal.en: Movere means 'move' and pro- means 'forward': promote is to move someone or something forward.
normal.cn: movere 意为“移动”，pro- 意为“向前”：promote 就是把某人或某物向前移。

normal.en: The same push serves a career, a cause, a product, and a pawn: all are moved up or forward.
normal.cn: 同一个推动服务职业、事业、产品与棋子：它们都被向上或向前推。

normal.en: Remote is re- plus movere, 'moved back'; promote is pro- plus movere, 'moved forward'. One prefix, two directions.
normal.cn: remote 是 re- 加 movere，“被移开”；promote 是 pro- 加 movere，“被推向前”。一个前缀，两个方向。

normal.en: In sport, promotion is the reward for finishing high, and relegation is its mirror image.
normal.cn: 体育中，升级是名列前茅的奖赏，降级是它的镜像。

normal.en: A catalyst promotes a reaction without being consumed: it pushes the process forward and stays.
normal.cn: 催化剂促进反应而自身不被消耗：它把过程推向前，并留在原地。

abstract.en: Advancement is a spatial metaphor: we imagine a career as a ladder and call each step a promotion.
abstract.cn: 晋升是一种空间隐喻：我们把职业想象成梯子，把每一级称作 promotion。

abstract.en: To promote an idea is to give it momentum in other minds, not merely to mention it.
abstract.cn: 推动一个理念，是给它在他者心智中的动量，而不只是提到它。

abstract.en: The chess pawn shows the metaphor literally: the lowest piece can become the highest by reaching the far rank.
abstract.cn: 国际象棋的兵把隐喻变成字面：最低的子只要走到远端，就能变成最高的子。

examples.en: She was promoted to senior manager last month.
examples.cn: 她上个月被提升为高级经理。

examples.en: The campaign promotes recycling in schools.
examples.cn: 这场运动在学校推广回收。

examples.en: Exercise promotes good health at every age.
examples.cn: 运动在各年龄段都促进健康。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若谋特”——扑过去谋划，把特出的人往上推 → promote 提升、促进

root: 拉丁语 promovere“向前移”，由 pro-“向前”+ movere“移动”构成；同族有 move、remove、motive、emotion。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of promote, all the same forward push. The push can raise a person, grow a cause, sell a product, advance a pupil, crown a pawn, or speed a reaction.
sensesIntro.cn: promote 的九个义项，都是同一个向前推动。这个推可以提升一个人、壮大一项事业、卖出产品、让学生升级、让兵升变，或加速反应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pushing a person or thing forward and upward.
core.cn: 核心意象：把人或物向前、向上推。

branches.en: RANK: a person, pupil, or team moves to a higher level.
branches.cn: 等级：人、学生或球队移到更高层。

branches.en: GROWTH: causes and values are given momentum in the world.
branches.cn: 成长：事业与价值在世界中获得动量。

branches.en: MARKET: goods are pushed toward buyers through publicity.
branches.cn: 市场：商品通过宣传被推向买家。

branches.en: GAME: a pawn reaches the far rank and becomes a stronger piece.
branches.cn: 游戏：兵走到远端，变成更强的子。

branches.en: PROCESS: chemistry speeds a reaction, and the archaic sense keeps the physical push.
branches.cn: 过程：化学加速反应，古义保留物理推动。

intro.en: Promote is a Latin verb. English adds -ion, -er, and -ional, and the root movere also builds move, remove, motive, and emotion.
intro.cn: promote 是拉丁动词。英语加 -ion、-er、-ional，词根 movere 还构成 move、remove、motive、emotion。

latinIntro.en: Latin promovere 'move forward' joins pro- 'forward' to movere 'move'. The same movere appears in remote (moved back), remove, and motive.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 promovere“向前移”把 pro-“向前”与 movere“移动”结合。同一个 movere 出现在 remote（移开）、remove、motive。

items.meaning: a rise in rank; a marketing campaign
items.meaningCN: 晋升；促销（-ion 构成名词）

items.meaning: one who organizes or backs something
worthy of being raised in rank
a reason that moves a person
a feeling that moves a person outward

definition_zh: 晋升；促销；推广；提倡；升级
definition_en: the act of moving someone or something forward, whether in rank, in sales or in public acceptance
core_image: 一只手把站在后排的人往前推一步，推到灯下；同一只手又把商品往前推，推到顾客手边
scene: 货架端头的折扣牌被推到最显眼处，仓储里的存货被搬到顾客手边。The promotion cut every price by a third for the weekend.
sceneCN: 货架端头的折扣牌被推到最显眼处，仓库里的存货被搬到顾客手边；句中的这个词指「为拉动销量而设的优惠活动」（第 2 个义项：以降价、赠品等方式在短期内推动销量的做法）。图中可辨识物件：货架端头、折扣牌、堆叠的存货、价签、伸出的手；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 晋升；提拔（可数）
促销活动；优惠活动（可数，商业用语）
推广；提倡；促进（不可数）

derivatives.zh: 推动；晋升；推广
推动者；主办者
促销的；推广的

senses.title: A move to a higher rank
senses.definition: a move to a higher position or rank at work
senses.definitionCN: 在工作上被移到更高的职位或级别
senses.example: She was given a promotion after the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 审计结束后她得到了晋升。
senses.why: Pro- 'forward' plus movere 'to move' gives 'a moving forward', and a career ladder is climbed one step at a time.
senses.whyCN: pro-「向前」加 movere「移动」构成「往前移」，而职业阶梯正是一步一步往上走的。

senses.title: A special offer to raise sales
senses.definition: a special offer, such as a discount or a gift, designed to raise sales quickly
senses.definitionCN: 以降价或赠品等方式在短期内快速拉动销量的特殊优惠
senses.example: The store ran a two-for-one promotion on coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店做了咖啡买一送一的促销。
senses.why: The same forward push is applied to goods: they are moved toward the buyer's hand rather than a person toward a higher desk.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「往前推」用在货物上：被推向顾客手边的是商品，而不是人被推向更高的职位。

senses.title: Publicity to make something accepted
senses.definition: organized publicity intended to make a product, event or idea accepted
senses.definitionCN: 为使产品、活动或理念被接受而组织起来的推广宣传
senses.example: The film's promotion included interviews in six cities.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的推广包括在六个城市做访谈。
senses.why: Moving a thing forward in public is the same verb, with reputation standing in for rank.
senses.whyCN: 在公众面前把某物往前推仍是同一个动词，只是「级别」换成了「名声」。

senses.title: Active support for a cause
senses.titleCN: 对某项事业的提倡与支持
senses.definition: active support for a cause, habit or practice
senses.definitionCN: 对某项事业、习惯或做法的积极支持
senses.example: The programme is a promotion of healthier eating in schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目是对校园健康饮食的提倡。
senses.why: To promote a cause is to push it forward until other people take it up.
senses.whyCN: 提倡一项事业，就是把它往前推，直到别人也接受它。

senses.title: The discounted item itself
senses.definition: in British usage, a product sold at a reduced price or offered as an inducement
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中指降价出售或作为诱因提供的产品
senses.example: The supermarket's promotions were stacked by the entrance.
senses.exampleCN: 超市的促销品堆在入口旁。
senses.why: The abstract push turns concrete: the thing used to push sales takes the name of the push.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的「推」变具体了：被用来推动销量的那件东西，直接借用了「推」这个名字。

senses.title: The prospect of rising
senses.definition: the possibility of being moved to a higher rank, rather than the move itself
senses.definitionCN: 被提到更高职位的可能性，而不是那次调动本身
senses.example: There is little promotion in a flat organization.
senses.exampleCN: 在扁平的组织里几乎没有晋升机会。
senses.why: An uncountable reading names the prospect instead of the finished event.
senses.whyCN: 不可数的读法指的是「有这种可能」，而不是已经完成的那个事件。

senses.title: A team moving up a division
senses.definition: the movement of a sports team into a higher division
senses.definitionCN: 运动队被提升到更高一级联赛
senses.example: The club celebrated its promotion to the first division.
senses.exampleCN: 俱乐部庆祝球队升入甲级。
senses.why: A league is a ladder too, and a team climbs it by exactly the same forward step.
senses.whyCN: 联赛也是一把梯子，球队往上爬走的是完全同一个「向前一步」。

senses.title: Advancing a condition or process
senses.definition: the advancement of a condition or process, as in health promotion
senses.definitionCN: 推动某种状态或过程向前，如健康促进
senses.example: Health promotion focuses on prevention rather than treatment.
senses.exampleCN: 健康促进重在预防而不是治疗。
senses.why: What is pushed forward is now an abstract good, a state of health rather than a person or a product.
senses.whyCN: 这里被往前推的是一个抽象的好东西，是健康状况，而不是一个人或一件商品。

intro.en: Promotion is the noun of Latin promovere 'to move forward'. Rank came first, sales came much later.
intro.cn: promotion 是拉丁 promovere「向前移动」的名词形式。先有的是职位义，卖货义要晚得多。

items.en: Movere meant 'to move'. Its participle motus gives English motive and motion, and it works inside remove, emotion and commotion.
items.cn: movere 意为「移动」。它的分词 motus 给了英语 motive 与 motion，也藏在 remove、emotion、commotion 里。

items.en: Pro- 'forward, forth' plus movere produced promovere 'to move forward, to advance, to bring to notice'.
items.cn: pro-「向前、往外」加 movere 构成 promovere「向前移、推进、使被注意」。

items.en: The action noun promotio named the act of advancing. English took both the noun and the verb, the verb through French.
items.cn: 动作名词 promotio 指「推进」这个动作。英语把名词和动词都借了进来，动词是经法语来的。

items.en: The earliest English sense is advancement in rank or dignity, first in church and university usage.
items.cn: 英语最早的意思是职位或地位的提升，最初用于教会与大学。

items.en: American trade writing applied the word to efforts that push goods toward buyers, and sales promotion became a fixed term.
items.cn: 十九世纪的美国商业写作把这个词用于「把商品推向买家」的努力，sales promotion 成了固定说法。

items.en: The twentieth century added large-scale publicity and health promotion, and the word now covers any forward push.
items.cn: 二十世纪又添上了大规模宣传与健康促进，这个词如今涵盖任何向前的推动。

note.en: Group one shares the moving-forward root; group two names neighbouring commercial actions.
note.cn: 第一组共享「向前移动」的词根；第二组是相邻的商业动作。

entries.definition: The verb: to move someone or something forward. The noun adds -ion.
entries.definitionCN: 动词：把人或物往前推。名词多一个 -ion。

entries.definition: The person who pushes a project or a fight; a countable role, not the act.
entries.definitionCN: 推动某个项目或赛事的人；是可数角色，不是动作本身。

entries.definition: The adjective describing material or offers used for promotion.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，描述用于推广的材料或优惠。

entries.definition: A headland, from mons 'mountain'; it looks like promotion but has no movere inside.
entries.definitionCN: 海角，出自 mons「山」；外形像 promotion，里面却没有 movere。

entries.definition: A single paid notice; promotion is the wider effort that may contain many notices and discounts.
entries.definitionCN: 单则付费告示；promotion 是更宽的努力，可包含许多告示与折扣。

entries.definition: Progress in rank or skill, usually without the commercial sense of selling goods.
entries.definitionCN: 职位或技能上的进步，通常不含推销商品的商业义。

entries.definition: A planned series of actions over a period; promotion can be a single offer or a whole strategy.
entries.definitionCN: 一段时期内计划好的一连串行动；promotion 可以只是单次优惠，也可以是一整套策略。

entries.definition: The attention gained, often unpaid; promotion is the deliberate effort to gain it.
entries.definitionCN: 获得的关注，往往不付费；promotion 则是刻意去争取这份关注的努力。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin pieces and real derived words.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁语构件与真实的派生词。

normal.en: pro- 'forward' + mot- 'move': promotion is a move forward.
normal.cn: pro-「向前」加 mot-「移动」：promotion 就是一次向前移。

normal.en: The family runs promote, promotion, promoter, promotional.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 promote、promotion、promoter、promotional。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the senses: win a promotion, a sales promotion, health promotion.
normal.cn: 固定搭配把义项分开：获得晋升、促销活动、健康促进。

normal.en: The same mot- root sits in motion, motive, emotion and remove.
normal.cn: 同一个 mot- 词根还在 motion、motive、emotion 与 remove 里。

normal.en: A league table uses the word literally: promotion to a higher division.
normal.cn: 联赛积分榜把这个词用得很实在：升入更高一级。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on someone's back, pushing gently: that push is the whole word.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手放在某人背上轻轻往前推：这一推就是整个词的意思。

abstract.en: The push can act on a person (rank), a product (sales) or an idea (publicity).
abstract.cn: 这一推可以作用在人（级别）、作用于商品（销量）或作用于理念（宣传）。

abstract.en: Nothing moves by itself; promotion always needs a pushing hand.
abstract.cn: 没有东西会自己往前移；promotion 永远需要一只推动的手。

examples.en: He earned his promotion by rebuilding the entire accounts system.
examples.cn: 他靠重建整套账务系统赢得了晋升。

examples.en: The bookshop's winter promotion gives a free novel with every three bought.
examples.cn: 这家书店的冬季促销是买三本送一本小说。

examples.en: The agency handles promotion for the city's film festival.
examples.cn: 这家代理公司负责这座城市电影节的推广。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普若-摩申」——普若（向前）一摩，人就升上去了，货也推到手边 → promotion 晋升、促销

root: 拉丁 promovere「向前移动、推进」= pro-（向前）+ movere「移动」；动作名词 promotio。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses are one push forward: up a career ladder, toward a buyer's hand, into public acceptance, into a league above, or into a better condition.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都是同一个「往前推」：沿职业阶梯往上、推向顾客的手边、推进公众的接受、推进更高一级的联赛，或者推向更好的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand pushes something one step forward into the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把某物往前推一步，推进光里。

branches.en: LADDER: the finished move up and the mere prospect of it are the same step seen as event and as chance.
branches.cn: 阶梯：已经完成的上升与仅仅存在的上升可能，是同一步的「事件」与「机会」两面。

branches.en: GOODS: the offer pushes sales, and the discounted item takes the name of the push itself.
branches.cn: 货物：优惠动作推动销量，而被降价的那件东西直接借用了这个动作的名字。

branches.en: PUBLICITY: reputation is pushed forward instead of a person or a product.
branches.cn: 名声：被往前推的是声誉，而不是一个人或一件商品。

branches.en: CAUSE AND CONDITION: a practice or a state of health is pushed until others take it up.
branches.cn: 事业与状态：一种做法或一种健康状况被推到别人也接受为止。

branches.en: LEAGUE: a division table is a ladder in plain visible form.
branches.cn: 联赛：分级表就是一把看得见的梯子。

intro.en: Promotion is a Latin prefix, a Latin root and a Latin noun ending, all three of which build other English words.
intro.cn: promotion 由拉丁前缀、拉丁词根与拉丁名词词尾构成，三部分都还能构成别的英语词。

latinIntro.en: Promovere 'to move forward' is pro- plus movere; the same movere gives motion, motive, remove and emotion.
latinIntro.cn: promovere「向前移」是 pro- 加 movere；同一个 movere 还给了 motion、motive、remove 与 emotion。

items.example: The prefix gives the direction of the push.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀给出推动的方向。

items.example: Motion and motive share this root.
items.exampleCN: motion 与 motive 共享这个词根。

items.meaning: the act or result of an action
items.example: The suffix makes an action noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀造出动作名词。

items.meaning: the act or result of pushing forward
items.example: The promotion lifted sales by half.
items.exampleCN: 这次促销把销量提高了一半。

items.meaning: a reason that moves a person
items.example: Profit was not his only motive.
items.exampleCN: 利润并非他唯一的动机。

items.meaning: a feeling that moves one outward
items.exampleCN: 那场演讲激起了强烈情绪。

items.meaning: to move something back or away
